visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Marks Are Sorted in Ascending Order
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The students should be ranked by marks from high to low, then by name, but the program lists the lowest marks first.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
students = [("Ravi", 72), ("Meena", 91), ("Kiran", 72), ("Asha", 91)]
by_marks = sorted(students, key=lambda s: (s[1], s[0]))
print(by_marks)

solution.code:
students = [("Ravi", 72), ("Meena", 91), ("Kiran", 72), ("Asha", 91)]
by_marks = sorted(students, key=lambda s: (-s[1], s[0]))
print(by_marks)
solution.explanation: Python sorts keys from small to large. Negating the marks turns "highest first" into "smallest negative number first". Without the minus sign the lowest marks come first.
